content.title: City Attorney's Office (Legal)
content.summary: The City Attorney's Office is dedicated to providing legal counsel and risk management services to the City Council, boards, commissions, and departments, while also prosecuting criminal defendants and code violations. It represents the City in various courts and prepares legal documents, emphasizing the importance of legal advice in advancing the City's interests. For legal assistance, individuals are advised to contact a private attorney.
content.body:
## Mission

The Mission of the City Attorney's Office is to analyze and use data to provide results-oriented legal advice and risk management services in order to advance the City’s best interests.

## Legal

### Services

- Provides legal counsel and services to the City Council.
- Provides legal counsel to boards, commissions, and City departments.
- Prosecutes criminal defendants.
- Prosecutes Arvada code violations. Municipal Code helps to ensure the safety of buildings and much more.
- Provides civil defense counsel for the City and employees in administrative, county, state, and federal courts.
- Represents the City in administrative, county, state, and federal courts.
- Prepares contracts and other legal documents.

### Contact

If you need legal help, please contact a private attorney.

### [Prosecution FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=79)

[I received a ticket from the Arvada Police Department (APD). Do I have to go to court?](#)
:   Please read the back of your ticket.  If your ticket says, “Mandatory Court,” you must appear on the date and time listed on your ticket. If you do not appear in the Arvada Municipal Court on that date and at that time, the Court may issue a warrant for your arrest.

    However, if your ticket says, “Total Fines and Costs…”, you do not need to appear.  Instead, if you do not wish to contest the ticket, you may pay the ticket in lieu of appearing in court. However, if you wish to contest the ticket, you must appear on the date and time listed on your ticket. If you fail to appear or pay, the Court may enter a default judgment against you.

    Note: Some APD tickets are issued into Arvada Municipal Court.  Others are issued into either the Adams or Jefferson County Courts.  Please make sure you know which Court you are supposed to report to – you can find this information by reading your ticket.

[My client received a ticket. How do I submit a copy of my Entry of Appearance to the prosecutor’s office?](#)
:   If you are an attorney, please submit your Entry of Appearance by email, postal service, or fax.

    - **Email:** [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2a5a5845594f495f5e4345446a4b585c4b4e4b0445584d);
    - **Mail:** 8101 Ralston Rd., Arvada, CO, 80002 with “ATTN: City Attorney’s Office”
    - **Fax:** 720-898-7175.

[What will happen when I appear in court on the date on my ticket?](#)
:   The date and time listed on your ticket is a summons to appear for your first appearance, or "arraignment." You will be notified of your legal rights at your arraignment, and will have the opportunity to enter your plea (e.g., guilty or not guilty) before the Judge. However, before you enter your plea, you will be able to speak with a prosecutor about a possible "plea bargain." Your plea will determine next steps. If you plead guilty, the Judge will typically enter a sentence that day. If you plead not guilty, you will be scheduled to return to court for a pre-trial conference.

[What if I am unable to appear for the court date listed on my ticket?](#)
:   If you need to reschedule your court date or request a continuance, you must contact the Arvada Municipal Court (720-898-7150; 8101 Ralston Rd., Arvada, CO, 80002) in advance of your hearing. The City Attorney’s Office cannot reschedule your court date for you.

[How do I get discovery on my case?](#)
:   "Discovery" is the name for the exchange of information between a defendant and the prosecution.  This includes evidence to be presented at trial. You must submit a written request in order to receive discovery from the prosecution.  This may be done through an Entry of Appearance (if you are represented by an attorney); by filling out a written request form at the front windows of the municipal court at City Hall; or by submitting a [request online](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32712). Please note: the fee for discovery in a traffic case is $2.00; in criminal (ordinance) cases, the fee is $10.00.

[Is everyone entitled to or eligible for a “plea bargain”?](#)
:   No one is entitled to a plea bargain.  However, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to your driving or criminal history and other circumstances related to your case, a prosecutor may offer you a plea bargain.

[Can the prosecutor give me legal advice about my case?](#)
:   No. A city prosecutor represents the People of the City of Arvada. As a result, they cannot provide legal advice about your case. However, the prosecutor will be able to provide basic information about your case (e.g., next steps in the process).

[How do I get in contact with the prosecutor assigned to my case?](#)
:   **Defendants:** You will have a chance to speak with the prosecutor at your arraignment. This is your time and opportunity to speak with them. If you need additional time after your arraignment, you can set the matter for a pre-trial conference with the prosecutor.

    **Victims:** Call 720-898-7180, or email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#7a0a0815091f190f0e1315143a1b080c1b1e1b5415081d)

## Risk and Safety Management

The City of Arvada’s Risk and Safety Management Division oversees the City's insurance program, adjusts liability, property and casualty, and workers’ compensation claims, and helps promote and maintain workplace safety initiatives.

### Filing a Claim Against the City

If you believe the City is responsible for damage or injury, you may file a claim. Please check with your own insurer first; if they determine the City is liable, they may handle reimbursement directly.

Colorado law requires written notice within 182 days of discovering the injury or damage. Missing this deadline may affect your claim.

#### How to File

1. [**Download and complete the Claim Form**](/DocumentCenter/View/211/Claim-Form-PDF?bidId=). Incomplete forms may delay review.
2. **Include details:** description of incident, date/time/location, damages, estimates/receipts, police report (if any), contact info, and your signature.
3. **Submit by email or mail:**
   - **Email**: [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8cefe4f9e2f8e0e9f5ccedfefaede8eda2e3feeb)
   - **Mail**: City of Arvada, Risk & Safety Management, 8101 Ralston Rd, Arvada, CO 80002

A Risk and Safety representative will follow up after your claim is received.

#### Important Notes

- Submitting a claim does not guarantee payment.
- Claims are reviewed based on law, shared liability, and depreciated (not replacement) value.
- City emergency response does not mean the City accepts liability.

**Questions?** Contact [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8dffe4fee6d2e0ece3eceae8e0e8e3f9cdecfffbece9eca3e2ffea).
